input_controller.inside_registered_gap: pause_then_skip_remaining_exact_zero_gap; if the model produces no audio within silence_cap_sec of the gap start, skip the remaining gap and resume the debater input immediately

_decision: silence_cap_sec 2.0 added 2026-09-13. A gap where the model stays silent used to play out in full — 13 s of dead air at A3-1, 8.6 s at B2 — which reads as a broken debate rather than a moderator who said nothing. 2.0 s is the end of the ON_TIME window, so a model that answers in time is never cut off and one that answers late now collides with the next debater, which is what a real debate does. Overlay codes (A4, A4xf, A5) have no registered gap and are unaffected.
